format: html

---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)
library(dbplyr)
```

```{r}
con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), dbdir = "data/atus.duckdb")

dbplyr_act <- tbl(con, "activities")
dbplyr_resp <- tbl(con, "respondents")
dbplyr_codes <- tbl(con, "activity_codes")
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
activity_avg <- dbplyr_resp |>
  filter(day_type == "Weekday", employment_status == "Not in labor force") |>
  inner_join(dbplyr_act, by = "tucaseid") |>
  inner_join(dbplyr_codes, by = "activity_code") |>
  group_by(sex, major_name) |>
  summarise(total_minutes = sum(duration_min), .groups = "drop") |>
  inner_join(
    dbplyr_resp |>
      filter(day_type == "Weekday", employment_status == "Not in labor force") |>
      count(sex),
    by = "sex"
  ) |>
  mutate(mean_minutes = total_minutes / n) |>
  select(sex, major_name, mean_minutes) |>
  collect()
```

```{r}
keep_cats <- c(
  "Personal Care Activities",
  "Household Activities",
  "Caring For & Helping Household (HH) Members",
  "Socializing, Relaxing, and Leisure"
)

hourly_avg <- dbplyr_act |>
  mutate(hour = start_hhmm %/% 100L) |>
  filter(hour >= 6L, hour <= 23L) |>
  left_join(dbplyr_codes |> select(activity_code, major_name),
            by = "activity_code") |>
  filter(major_name %in% keep_cats) |>
  inner_join(dbplyr_resp |>
               filter(str_starts(employment_status, "Not"),
                      day_type == "Weekday") |>
               select(tucaseid, sex),
             by = "tucaseid") |>
  group_by(sex, hour, major_name) |>
  summarise(avg_min = mean(duration_min, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  collect()

hourly_avg
```

```{r}
activity_avg |>
  filter(major_name != "Data Codes") |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = fct_reorder(major_name, mean_minutes),
    y = mean_minutes,
    fill = sex
  )) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Weekday Activity Time by Sex",
    subtitle = "Weekday respondents not in the labor force",
    x = "Major activity category",
    y = "Average minutes per day",
    fill = "Sex",
    caption = "Source: American Time Use Survey (ATUS)"
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(hourly_avg, aes(x = hour, y = avg_min, fill = major_name)) +
  geom_area(color = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
  facet_wrap(~sex, nrow = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(6, 10, 14, 18, 22),
    labels = c("6 AM", "10 AM", "2 PM", "6 PM", "10 PM")
  ) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "How Weekday Activity Time Fills the Day",
    subtitle = "Average minutes spent in activities starting each hour",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Average minutes",
    fill = "Major activity category",
    caption = "Source: American Time Use Survey (ATUS)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```
